text.p: TORONTO, July 28 Reuter) - The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THE GLOBE AND MAIL: Smugglers go interprovincial: Profits high, chances of getting caught low in the business of contraband cigarettes
-Consumer splurges, economy surges: Job growth ond higher earning capapcity tweak confidence.
-Germany, Poland prepare for worst as river rises: Soldiers scramble to shore up dikes as 17,000 flee Polish city for second time
-Women lose out on care after heart attack: Study shows men get more aggressive treatment and more of them improve
-AFN rivals embody competing visions: Moderate Fontaine, revolutionary Mercredi take different approaches to struggle for native sovereignty
Report on Business Section: Business optimism surges: Study says confidence fed by hot stock market, low inflation and robust economic growth
-Juggling jobs a '90s necessity: Only half of Canadians work a standard week, while more are answering to multiple masters to make ends meet.
-Fall TV expected to draw ad dollars: Analyst expects 'pretty good year'
'I did not participate in any tampering,' Felderhof
-Troubled Gandalf files for protection: More than half staff fired but Royal Bank provides line of credit
-Return to golden era at Molson looks elusive
